title: What are you doing this year?
grammar: Present continuous: Wh- questions; talking about this year
vocab_topic: School subjects, clubs, sports and activities
pair_game: Point at a picture. Ask: “What are you doing this year?” Your partner answers. Then swap!
questions: What are you doing in school this year?
Are you playing any sports this year?
What is your favorite subject this year?
Who is your best friend this year?
Are you learning English this year?
What club or activity are you in?
Do you have a new teacher this year?
What are you good at this year?
Are you singing or dancing in school?
Tell us about your best friend.
starters: Yes, I am playing … . / No, I am not.
My favourite subject this year is … because … .
My best friend this year is … . He/She is … .
Yes, I am learning English because … .
I am in the … club. We meet on … .
Yes, I do. My new teacher is … . / No, I do not.
This year I am good at … .
Yes, I am. / No, I am not. I am … .
My best friend is … . We … together.
samples: What are you doing in school this year?
This year I **am learning** English and I **am playing** football. I **am also singing** in the school concert.
What club or activity are you in?
I am in the chess club. We meet on Mondays after school. I **am learning** new moves every week.
Tell us about your best friend.
My best friend is Jasur. He is twelve. He is funny and kind. We **are sitting** together this year.

survey.title: Class survey
survey.question: What club or sport are you doing this year?

game.title: Spin and talk!
game.rules: Spin the pencil. Talk for 20 seconds about the topic. Your group counts your sentences!

mini_talk.title: My school year
plan: Say what year you are in
Say what club or sport you do
Say who your best friend is
mini_talk.model: This year I am in Class 6 and it is my favourite year. I **am studying** English, maths and history. On Wednesdays I **am playing** basketball with the school team, and at home I **am learning** the guitar. My best friend is Malika. We **are sitting** together and we **are doing** our science project together too.

cando: talk about my clubs and sports this year
